name: Bounce
description: The first clip drops out of the frame with a few bounces, revealing the second. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: shadow_colour
params.description: Color of the shadow cast on the second clip; its alpha is the strength

params.name: shadow_height
params.description: Height of the shadow, relative to the frame height
